items.t: The CLARITY Act vote: what actually happened, and what the bill does
items.note: Blog · news-analysis · query: CLARITY Act / crypto market structure bill (promoted by Travis 2026-09-15). ⚠️ WRITE THE OUTCOME, DO NOT ASSUME IT. The cloture vote was set for Tue 9/15 2:15pm ET and needed 60 votes against a 53-seat majority; prediction markets priced passage in 2026 near 16%. VERIFY what actually happened before writing a word — cloture carried, failed, or was pulled — and cite a primary source (Senate roll call, or Reuters/CNBC/The Block reporting it). Angle: explain what the bill actually does so the post keeps earning after the news cycle — the three fights that held it up (ethics rules on the President's crypto income, DeFi developer liability under Section 604, the stablecoin yield provision), and what each outcome means for self-custody and for builders. NO Swop product claims beyond Verified FACTS rows, and no predictions about what Congress does next. Note FOMC lands the same day — the newsletter covers that, not this post.
